title: Every soccer ball hides exactly twelve pentagons
body: A ball sewn from hexagons alone cannot close into a sphere; Euler's formula forces exactly twelve pentagonal defects among the hexagons, however many hexagons you add. Carbon's buckminsterfullerene molecule obeys the same count. It is a lovely jail: topology does not negotiate with sports equipment or chemistry.
source_hint: Euler characteristic applied to fullerene/truncated icosahedron
